literal: In the ground the nature of what lay the sprout will show; will show in the lineage those born mouth's word.
translation: Just as a sprout reveals the nature of the soil in which it grew, the words from their mouths reveal the lineage of those born into it.
modern: ஒரு நிலத்தின் தன்மையை அதில் முளைக்கும் முளை காட்டும். அதுபோல, ஒரு குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களின் தன்மையை அவர்கள் வாயிலிருந்து வரும் சொற்கள் காட்டும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a simple agricultural analogy to explain how speech reflects one's background. The sprout that emerges from the ground indicates the quality and nature of the soil beneath it. In the exact same way, the words that come out of a person's mouth reveal the nature of the family and lineage in which they were raised. The repetition of the word 'காட்டும்' (will show) emphasizes the certainty of this revelation. The word 'கால்' here takes the specific meaning of a sprout or shoot, fitting the botanical imagery perfectly.
